messages.subject: Error in proteinSummarization
parts:
Dear MSstats team, 

I am running an experiment using TMTpro 16plex with 4 conditions using 4 biological replicates. The sample is fractionated into 6 fractions and I process the raw spectra with MaxQuant. 

I encounter the following error when running proteinSummarization(input.mq, reference_norm=FALSE):
"Error in vecseq(f__, len__, if (allow.cartesian || notjoin || !anyDuplicated(f__,  : 

  Join results in 1085360 rows; more than 775436 = nrow(x)+nrow(i). Check for duplicate key values in i each of which join to the same group in x over and over again. If that's ok, try by=.EACHI to run j for each group to avoid the large allocation. If you are sure you wish to proceed, rerun with allow.cartesian=TRUE. Otherwise, please search for this error message in the FAQ, Wiki, Stack Overflow and data.table issue tracker for advice."

R version 4.3.2 (2023-10-31)

Platform: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu (64-bit)

Running under: Ubuntu 20.04.6 LTS

MSstatsTMT_2.8.0


The script I use for processing this type of experimental setup usually works well, and I am encountering this error for the first time.

I attached the input.mq file and the annotation file in this link, let me know if there is anything else needed for troubleshooting.

Thank you so much for any input! :)

Best wishes,
Anna
